demo.title: Public demo: the Rímac scenario
demo.intro: It simulates the river being dammed: discharge drops at Chaclacayo and, 4 minutes later, Santa Eulalia stops reporting. Willay opens two incidents, alerts by email and escalates to the next level if nobody acknowledges. It takes 9 minutes.
demo.restoring: The demo is going back to its initial state; it will be ready in a few seconds.

phases.drop: Discharge drops at Chaclacayo: an incident opens
phases.silence: Santa Eulalia stops reporting: another one opens

demo.whilePlaying: While it plays, open an incident and acknowledge it, or acknowledge it from its email.
demo.failed: The last run could not finish. Try again.
demo.busy: A run is already in progress: wait for it to finish.
demo.startFailed: The scenario could not start. Try again.

demoAccess.title: Try Willay
demoAccess.intro: This is a public demo with simulated data. Sign in with one of these accounts:
demoAccess.admin: sees and manages everything, and runs the scenario
demoAccess.operator: manages zones, stations, rules and incidents
demoAccess.step3: Follow the live map: the first incident opens within a minute.
demoAccess.step4: Acknowledge it from the incident or from its email.
demoAccess.reset: Every night at 04:00 (Lima time) the demo goes back to its initial state.
